headline: QuantumScape shares jump following narrower quarterly loss
summary: QuantumScape shares rose after the company reported a narrower quarterly loss for the period.
why: Development-stage battery technology firms rely heavily on capital markets and operational milestone updates to sustain valuations before commercialization.

impacts.name: QuantumScape
impacts.why: A narrower-than-expected quarterly loss improved investor sentiment regarding the company's capital burn rate.

why_moved: Investors reacted positively to reduced net losses, signaling improved near-term financial management.
